features.title: Shareable escrow links
features.description: Create an escrow and send a payment link over WhatsApp, Instagram, email, or SMS. Buyers fund it in minutes with card or bank transfer.

features.title: Instant funding alerts
features.description: Get notified the moment a buyer funds an escrow — by email, SMS, and in-app. Know exactly when to ship.

features.title: 24-hour payouts
features.description: Once the buyer confirms delivery, funds are released and paid to your Nigerian bank account within 24 hours.

features.title: Clear, capped fees
features.description: 1.5% per transaction, minimum ₦500, maximum ₦50,000. No hidden FX costs, no surprise charges.

features.title: Tracking & delivery proof
features.description: Submit tracking numbers and mark delivery so the buyer and the escrow timeline stay perfectly in sync.

features.title: Dispute protection
features.description: If a buyer raises a dispute, our team reviews evidence within 48 hours. Fair, fast, and evidence-based.
